review_evidence: SSA/Tests/Core/Refinement.lean contains typed refinement examples and guarded goals checking simp_denote/simp_llvm behavior against the PoisonOr/LLVM refinement relation.
SSA/Tests/Core/Print.lean and the Core test umbrella exercise the formal command representation and printing/refinement interfaces inside Lean.
The test placement alone is not a content-level reason to exclude these formal examples, and the tiny umbrella is already classified by FD-016.
summary: Retain the SSA test subtrees because they exercise the formal refinement API and encode searchable proof/tactic behavior rather than disposable non-formal test data.
